method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a right triangle with vertices C-B-A, a right angle marked at B, side lengths CB = 20, BA = 15, and hypotenuse CA = 25. The text asks for tan A as a decimal to the nearest hundredth. For angle A, the side opposite is CB and the adjacent leg is BA, so compute tan A = opposite/adjacent = 20/15 = 1.333..., then round to 1.33.

推理：要求 tan A。对于角 A，正对的边是 CB，长度为 20；相邻的直角边是 BA，长度为 15。因此 tan A = opposite/adjacent = 20/15 = 1.333...。四舍五入到百分位得到 1.33。
